preconditions.description: The number of operations n is between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= k <= i - 1 for i, k in enumerate([int(line.split()[0]) for line in lines[1:]], start=1))
preconditions.description: For each operation i (1-indexed), the number of edges k is between 0 and i-1 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= i - 1 for i, line in enumerate(lines[1:], start=1) for v in [int(x) for x in line.split()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each operation i, every referenced vertex v is strictly less than i.

preconditions.expression: all(abs(x) <= 10**9 for line in lines[1:] for x in [int(val) for val in line.split()[2::2]])
preconditions.description: For each operation, every weight offset x satisfies |x| <= 10^9.
The sum of k over all operations does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output is the sum of weights of all edges in the resulting forest modulo 10^9 + 7.

postconditions.expression: total_weight_sum == sum(depth(v) + x for v, x in all_edges)
postconditions.description: The total weight sum is the sum of (depth(v) + x) for every edge added from root(v) to the new vertex with offset x, where depth(v) is the sum of weights on the path from v to its root at the moment the edge is added.
